description.text: Curriculum Courses of Politics and Foreign Language are exempted; Introduction to China and Modern Chinese Language mandatory is required; - Others courses are taken as the same as Chinese students. - The student who has completed the 4-year curriculum, passed the examinations and successfully defended the thesis will be issued a diploma and conferred with a Bachelor degree.

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering at Jilin University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2361 USD/per year ￥ 17000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Certificate of HSK 6.Additional materials Additional materials may be required.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be at least 18 years old; 2.At least with a high school diploma. 3.The applicants have adequate HSK Band 6, the students whose Chinese language is not proficient enough may enroll first in a one-year Intensive Chinese Language Study Program.
